summary: Woman in her mid-to-late 50s drove a U-Haul truck off Highway 145 near Norwood Hill (mile marker 92.5, ~3 mi south of the bottom of Norwood Hill, 1 mi south of Beaver Creek Park, San Miguel Canyon) around 9 p.m.; the truck rolled multiple times and came to rest on the bank of the San Miguel River. Spotted ~7 a.m. the next morning by a passing truck driver; she was trapped in the cab with multiple internal injuries. ~1.5-hour technical rope rescue and extrication by Norwood Fire, Telluride Fire and Search and Rescue, sheriff's deputies, state patrol, and CDOT; flown to St. Mary's by CareFlight with serious but non-life-threatening injuries.
location: Highway 145 near Norwood Hill, San Miguel Canyon
responding_agency: Norwood Fire Protection District; Telluride Fire and Search and Rescue; San Miguel County Sheriff's Office; Colorado State Patrol; CDOT
notes: Date pinned via article's Monday, Aug. 26, 2024 (Monday-verified); discovered and rescued Aug. 27. Two cats traveling with her unaccounted for as of press time. Run 702 insert (San Miguel County SO news alerts chunk), parent-opened and verified.
